messages:
sara-csm: FYI — ClearwaterPay MAU down ~52% over last 10d. Renewal in 4w. Main PM (Aisha) moved teams. Need quick triage and short win plan. @matt-sales any intel on competitive activity?

matt-sales: Heard they're fielding a demo from VeloxAI. Procurement nudged them to compare cost/latency. Could be an expedited decision.

toni-eng: Telemetry shows sudden jump in average prompt size and concurrent sessions. We also logged several 429s and intermittent 504s. Snip: ```
2024-06-02T11:07:21Z clearwater-22 429 rate_limit
2024-06-02T11:07:22Z clearwater-22 504 upstream_timeout
```

sara-csm: Proposal: 1) offer a 10-day complementary Dedicated trial to validate production profile; 2) ops reproduce 429s with sanitized prompt set; 3) commercial prepare pilot credit and fast NDA. Owners?

matt-sales: I can own pilot terms & legal escalation. Will offer trial framed as "validate throughput + cost at peak."

toni-eng: I'll run repro in staging. Need sample prompt schema or anonymized examples. ETA 36h.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-12456 created: clearwater-22 high-rate-limits. Assigned to toni-eng.

sara-csm: Great. I'll schedule a 30m triage call for Wed and prep a 1-page perf brief (90th & token delta vs baseline). If trial proves gains, pitch a short reserved commit.

matt-sales: Invite sent for Wed 2pm ET. Commercial to join.

sara-csm: Thanks team — post repro results and I'll attach pre-read to invite. :thumbsup:
